coefficient_definition: Model intercept: treatment-cell grand mean at root d under sum coding for Cy and iPTH.
Cy sum-contrast coefficient (No coded +1, Yes coded -1); positive values indicate a higher outcome without Cy, averaged over iPTH.
iPTH sum-contrast coefficient (No coded +1, Yes coded -1); positive values indicate a higher outcome without iPTH, averaged over Cy.
Root m coefficient relative to reference root d.
Root p coefficient relative to reference root d.
Cy-by-iPTH interaction coefficient under sum coding; four times this coefficient equals the difference-in-differences.
